evidence.evidence_text: Knowledge distillation is an efficient method to compress models, which transfers knowledge from strong teacher models to weak student models.

The experimental results show that our 66M student model achieves the state-of-the-art performance among models with same parameters on multiple datasets, and is very competitive when compared with larger, even LLM-based, DPR models.
Knowledge distillation is an efficient method to compress models, which transfers knowledge from strong teacher models to weak student models.
